outcome: Presence of cariogenic and periodontal pathogens in infants' oral cavities
Quantity of cariogenic and periodontal pathogens in infants' oral cavities
cohort: 59 infants (35 vaginally delivered, 24 C-section) and their mothers
finding: Cariogenic bacteria, Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans and Fusobacterium nucleatum, are present in edentulous infants and increase after deciduous tooth eruption, but C-section delivery did not significantly influence early Streptococcus mutans colonization.
mod_finding: C-section delivery did not significantly influence early Streptococcus mutans colonization in infants.
